title: Kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet
intro: Corner-sharing triangles, 3 sites per unit cell.

questions.question: Exact ground-state energy per site of the 12-site (2x2 cell) kagome torus?
questions.explanation: Small cluster; the TL value is about -0.4386 (DMRG).

questions.question: Which spinon flux pattern defines the U(1) Dirac spin liquid (Ran-Hermele-Lee-Wen)?
questions.explanation: [0, pi]: Dirac cones at the Fermi level; Gutzwiller energy ~ -0.4287 J.

questions.question: VMC energy per site of the projected U(1) Dirac spin liquid (large torus)?
questions.explanation: Known value -0.42866(1); qslab gives -0.4291(9) on 108 sites.

questions.question: What is the classical ground-state degeneracy of the kagome AFM?
options: extensive (any configuration with total spin 0 on every triangle)
questions.explanation: Each triangle only needs S_triangle = 0: extensive degeneracy, so quantum fluctuations select the state.

questions.question: Which of these stabilises a chiral spin liquid on kagome?
options: J2 = J3 ~ 0.5 or a scalar chirality term Jchi
questions.explanation: He-Sheng-Chen (2014), Gong et al. (2014): a Kalmeyer-Laughlin state with C = 1/2.

questions.question: Topological entanglement entropy expected for a gapped Z2 spin liquid on kagome (nats)?
questions.explanation: Same anyon theory as the toric code: gamma = ln 2 (DMRG finds about 0.69).

questions.question: Why must the spinon Fermi sea be a closed shell before Gutzwiller projection?
options: Otherwise the projected state depends on arbitrary choices in a degenerate level
questions.explanation: Use twisted (antiperiodic) spinon boundary conditions or another cluster; qslab warns about open shells.
